Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players (selected) |
|-----|----------------------------|
| **Early years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Paul Westphal*, *Bobby Phills* |
| **1990s** | *Chris Kaman*, *Julius Erving* (short stint), *Darren Daye*, *Gary Grant* |
| **2000s (pre‑Kawhi era)** | *Blake Griffin* (draft‑year rookie), *DeAndre Jordan*, *Chris Paul* (first stint), *Jamal Crawford*, *Julius Randle* (early career) |
| **2010s (Kawhi & Paul era)** | *Kawhi Leonard*, *Paul George*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Julius Randle* (later years), *Jamal Crawford* (return), *Chris Paul* (second stint) |
| **2020s (current core)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Jamal Crawford* (coach now), *Julius Randle* (recent trade), *Bam Adebayo* (trade), *Jalen Green* (rookie), *Coby White* (rookie), *Julius Randle* (trade), *Jamal Crawford* (coach), *Julius Randle* (trade), *Julius Randle* (trade) |

> **Quick note:** The Clippers’ roster has evolved dramatically over the decades—from a struggling franchise in the 1970s to a modern powerhouse with multiple All‑Star talents. The list above highlights just a handful of the many players who have contributed to the team’s history.

If you’re looking for a more exhaustive list or specific seasons, let me know!
